Recent notes

  • LNL target designs in Geant4 2026-10-27

    Pierfrancesco’s Cu hemisphere and the flat diamond window, simulated with the MX17 arms as built and with the big plastics, at 1.03 and 1.10 MeV: reach, backgrounds, contamination, trigger and DREAM, scintillator load.

  • MX17 efficiency: where every track goes 2026-10-26Cosmic benchMicromegasEfficiency

    Every M3 track crossing a bench chamber followed to where it ends: det3 interior 91.2 % detected, 93.3 % found, 95.2 % of non-spark crossings; the rest is sparks, second particles, delta rays and the fit. All five chambers, interior and edge, 5 and 3 mm.

  • MX17 noise bands 2026-10-26Cosmic benchMicromegasNoise

    The bench noise bands: a gain-driven, ~1 ms, untriggered disturbance at a fixed spot of det3/det7 (not corruption, not pickup); a separate whole-plane family on det2/4/6.

  • MX17 x↔y pairing: simulation study 2026-10-26SimulationMicromegasReconstructionSame-chamber pairs

    Pairing two tracks' x and y by charge: gates on five bench chambers; the MX17_Geant response sim fails the x/y-split gate (×1.9, two located causes); simulated overlay at bench and n_TOF noise as a pessimistic bound.

  • Saturated delta blobs 2026-10-26Cosmic benchMicromegasReconstruction
  • det3 multi-particle events 2026-10-26Cosmic benchMicromegasReconstructionTwo-track

    det3 multi-particle cosmic events: second particles are muon knock-ons from the material above (upper M3 doublet); a steepness-based rule picks the trigger track 80 % vs production 54 %; bench two-track benchmark vs separation
